context: Two friends browse a sale at a goods store
purpose: Teach: 壊れ/絵画/電池/セール/雑貨/照明/バッグ/真似

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: わあ、ここの雑貨屋さん、今セール中だって。
lines.en: Wow, this goods shop is having a sale right now.
lines.style: Soft excited tone with slight upward inflection on discovery

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ほんとだ。間接照明とか、おしゃれな物いっぱいあるね。
lines.en: Really. There's lots of stylish stuff like indirect lighting.
lines.style: Calm warm voice, casual observation between close friends

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 見て、この絵画みたいなポスター、すごく素敵じゃない?
lines.en: Look, this painting-like poster, isn't it really lovely?
lines.style: Dreamy admiring tone, leaning in close to share

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね。あ、こっちのバッグも可愛い。半額になってるよ。
lines.en: Nice. Oh, this bag is cute too. It's half off.
lines.style: Bright practical voice, pointing out a good deal

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えー欲しい!でも私、すぐ友達の真似して買っちゃう癖があるから。
lines.en: Aww, I want it! But I have a habit of copying friends' purchases.
lines.style: Playful self-aware laugh with slight embarrassed lilt

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あはは、いいじゃん。あれ、この時計、針が動いてないよ。電池切れかな?
lines.en: Haha, that's fine. Huh, this clock's hands aren't moving. Dead battery maybe?
lines.style: Light laugh transitioning to curious puzzled tone naturally

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あ、ほんとだ。下のとこ、ちょっと壊れてるみたいに見えるけど。
lines.en: Oh, you're right. The bottom part looks kind of broken too.
lines.style: Gentle concerned voice while peering closely at item

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: じゃあセール品の訳ありコーナーかも。店員さんに聞いてみよっか。
lines.en: Then maybe it's in the discounted defects corner. Let's ask the clerk.
lines.style: Practical friendly suggestion with ready-to-act energy
